messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate & repeated fallback loop detected for routing-policy service in eu-west-1. >30% errors for generation requests, many clients seeing model mismatch. Paging oncall (severity: P2). See /incidents/2704567890.
Mia Chen: ack, taking initial triage. pulling logs now. any customer-facing pages? @support-bot can you surface recent tickets?
support-bot: 2 recent tickets from acme-corp and beta-app mentioning "unexpected model outputs" and timeouts. created support case 2026-03-15-ACME.
Jordan Lee: I'm on network/infra. I see a flood of policy-eval failures from the routing service around 08:13 UTC. Looks like a schema validation changed earlier in the deploy at 07:58.
Mia Chen: that matches. product rolled config schema v2 -> v3 yesterday evening. quick grep shows many policies now have an automatic fallback set to "legacy:true" because deprecated field `fallback_model` was left in configs and server treats it as enabled.
Mia Chen: snippet from the offending policy (from config store):
```
- id: route-xy
  model_variants:
    - name: xy-large
    - name: xy-small
  # old field left in user config
  fallback_model: true  # deprecated, was boolean in v2
```
Mia Chen: server-side v3 schema treats `fallback_model: true` as "enable automatic fallback to ANY variant", which causes churn and region failovers when variant selection fails -> repeated fallbacks.
Jordan Lee: timeline: 07:58 deploy of schema v3, 08:13 first error spike, 08:16 automated routing fallback loop started, 08:20 incident-bot alerted. seems deterministic.
Sam Patel: can we apply an immediate override to stop fallback behavior while we fix configs? I can push a routing override for eu-west-1 to pin `xy-large` for critical customers.
Mia Chen: yes. I'll run the emergency override. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing override apply --region eu-west-1 --policy route-xy --pin-variant xy-large --reason "mitigate fallback-loop"
```
Jordan Lee: applied override at 08:28 UTC. monitoring.
incident-bot: OVERRIDE: route-xy pinned to xy-large in eu-west-1 by Mia Chen (mitigation). Auto-expire 2h.
Rita Gomez: seeing errors drop to 3% in the metrics within 2 minutes. latency back to normal band for pinned traffic. Good catch.
Amir Singh: product note: acme-corp reports partial failures but accepts workaround; asked for root-cause and ETA for full fix.
Mia Chen: immediate mitigation: (1) override pinned, (2) temporarily revert schema behavior to ignore deprecated boolean fields at runtime, (3) start mass config sanitization.
Jordan Lee: doing a targeted hotfix to the schema validator to treat `fallback_model` as removed (ignore) until full migration is finished. Patch applied at 08:42 UTC.
Luca (oncall-sre): heads up, we should also add a validation check in the deploy pipeline to reject configs with deprecated fields. I'll open a quick PR.
Sam Patel: handing off to me for follow-up and customer comms. I'll own the postmortem tracking and follow-ups with support/product. Mia, Jordan please add any logs/traces to the incident doc.
Mia Chen: copying relevant traces and a short repro in the incident doc. repro steps:
1) create policy containing `fallback_model: true` and two variants
2) deploy schema v3
3) send variant-selection traffic that times out for first variant
4) server treats deprecated field as enable-any-fallback -> loops
Attached config diff we used for testing:
```
--- policy-old.yaml
+++ policy-new.yaml
@@
- fallback_model: true
+ # removed fallback_model
```
support-bot: Customer impact summary (pre-mitigation): ~1200 requests/min affected, 2 customers reported errors, SLO breach potential for 10m window. Post-mitigation: no further new support tickets.
Amir Singh: product will send an incident advisory to impacted customers by EOD. please include timeline and mitigation steps.
Sam Patel: follow-ups assigned:
- Mia: docs for mitigation commands + add incident playbook step (owner)
- Jordan: full patch to schema & pipeline validation PR (owner)
- Luca: CI guard to reject deprecated fields (owner)
- Rita: confirm telemetry shows no residual oscillation (owner)
- Sam: customer comms + postmortem (owner)
Mia Chen: adding a short root cause blurb: "Regression introduced by schema v3 interpretation of deprecated boolean `fallback_model` which defaulted to permissive fallback logic when present. Combined with variant-selection timeouts triggered by transient GPU pressure in eu-west-1, this produced rapid fallback oscillation across variants and regions."
Jordan Lee: mitigation & long-term fixes:
- fully remove deprecated field handling on server (breaking change, gated rollout)
- add strict migration tooling that rewrites old configs to explicit `fallback_strategy` values
- add metrics and alerting for fallback-rate per policy
Sam Patel: leaving handoff note: I'll be on-call for the rest of the incident timeline and will coordinate postmortem. next check-in 09:30 UTC. If anything re-escalates ping @pager.
Mia Chen: thanks all. tagging #product #support #eng-runtime for awareness. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated (override applied + schema hotfix). Incident state: monitoring. Incident doc: /incidents/2704567890. Severity downgraded to P3 at 08:45 UTC.
support-bot: Customers notified: acme-corp (case 2026-03-15-ACME), beta-app (case 2026-03-15-BETA). No SLA credits requested so far.
Sam Patel: postmortem draft will include timeline, contributing factors, mitigations, and a rollout plan for config migration. Will share in #postmortems by tomorrow.
Rita Gomez: adding note to Runbook: "If routing fallback loop suspected - pin critical policies, apply schema ignore of deprecated booleans, and open migration tickets." will PR shortly.
Luca (oncall-sre): PR created to pipeline: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7845 - rejects deprecated keys with clear error.
Mia Chen: final note: great job on the quick override. let's also schedule a tabletop to exercise schema migrations. :calendar:
Sam Patel: handing off to post-incident duties now. closing the pager. :hand:
